proposal.reason: Main change is a broad overhaul of open-source test workflows and xtest tooling: dual-platform (M890P+OAM-810E) case generation/grouping/execution, CI resource allocation and rack policy handling, default/override HPN SDK installation in workflow runs, expanded CI artifacts/reporting, and corresponding CI test-list/test-harness updates (including large patch-omitted test-list JSONs under tests/xtest).
